instruction: Fix `parse_kv` in `parselib/textutil.py` so only the *first* separator splits the line. The current code calls `split(sep)` without a maxsplit, so a value that itself contains '=' (e.g. `url = a=b=c`) raises a ValueError instead of returning `("url", "a=b=c")`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib/textutil.py b/parselib/textutil.py
--- a/parselib/textutil.py
+++ b/parselib/textutil.py
@@ -36,5 +36,5 @@
         return None
     if sep not in cleaned:
         raise ValueError(f"line has no '{sep}' separator: {line!r}")
-    key, value = cleaned.split(sep)
+    key, value = cleaned.split(sep, 1)
     return key.strip(), value.strip()
